name: Meera Boutique
tagline: Kurtis, kurta sets, lehengas and sarees
about:
Meera Boutique is a demo catalog for clothing shops, made by OneCatalog.
Pick a size on any product and it goes straight into your WhatsApp message. Each colour has its own page, so you can share the exact one.
The photos and the shop details here are examples.
metaDescription: Meera Boutique demo catalog. Kurtis, kurta sets, lehengas, sarees and blouses with sizes and colours. Order on WhatsApp.
